question: What percentage of trees in the Bronx have a health status of Good?
sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN boroname = 'Bronx' AND health = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as good_bronx_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN boroname = 'Bronx' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_bronx_count,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN boroname = 'Bronx' AND health = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN boroname = 'Bronx' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as percentage_good
FROM trees
WHERE boroname = 'Bronx'
